tasks.spec:
You are an engineer on freytag-forge. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the repo (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, NEVER call a model, NEVER use the network, never run `uv`, never run Playwright or any browser test. Write NOTES.txt (never committed) with any ambiguity and your choice.

You may edit ONLY: frontend/e2e/helpers.js. Touch nothing else.

PROBLEM (measured 2026-11-25 on staging). `startSceneSession` in frontend/e2e/helpers.js clicks New Session and then runs `await expect(page.locator("#status-line")).toContainText(...)` and `await expect(page.locator("#transcript")).not.toBeEmpty()` with Playwright's default 5 s expect timeout. A seeded session (`startScene` set) takes 3.5 to 5.0 s to create on staging, so a hosted blind-player run failed at its second replicate with the status line still reading 'Creating session...'. The same file already waits up to `TURN_TIMEOUT_MS` for slow server turns (for example `toBeEnabled({ timeout: TURN_TIMEOUT_MS })`).

WHAT TO DO. Pass `{ timeout: TURN_TIMEOUT_MS }` to both of those expectations in `startSceneSession`, the same way the file's other waits do. Change nothing else. No new test is needed (the change only lengthens a browser wait); run `cd frontend && node --test src/*.test.js e2e/*.test.js` to confirm nothing else breaks.
tasks.check:
set -e
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-34e
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
[ -e frontend/node_modules ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
git reset -q
git add -A -- . ':(exclude)NOTES.txt'
git reset -q -- frontend/node_modules 2>/dev/null || true
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^frontend/e2e/helpers\.js$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'toContainText(`Scene ${hasStartScene ? options.startScene : "1A"}`, { timeout: TURN_TIMEOUT_MS })' frontend/e2e/helpers.js || { echo "status-line wait does not use TURN_TIMEOUT_MS"; grep -n 'status-line' frontend/e2e/helpers.js; exit 1; }
grep -q 'locator("#transcript")).not.toBeEmpty({ timeout: TURN_TIMEOUT_MS })' frontend/e2e/helpers.js || { echo "transcript wait does not use TURN_TIMEOUT_MS"; grep -n 'transcript' frontend/e2e/helpers.js; exit 1; }
n=$(git diff --cached --numstat | awk '{s+=$1+$2} END {print s+0}')
echo "changed lines: $n"
[ "$n" -le 4 ] || { echo "more than the two expectations changed"; git diff --cached; exit 1; }
(cd frontend && PATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin:$PATH node --test src/*.test.js e2e/*.test.js) > "$WORK/out/node-test.txt" 2>&1 || { grep -nE "✖|ℹ fail" "$WORK/out/node-test.txt" | head -20; exit 1; }
grep -E "ℹ (pass|fail)" "$WORK/out/node-test.txt"
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/session-start-timeout.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/session-start-timeout.patch"
